notes.subject: פשט
notes.rationale: KJV 'spoileth' (ka minɛ) vs JPS 'spreadeth itself' (ka yɛlɛma) — Heburukan fɔcogo fila bɛ yen; an ta minɛcogo minɛlen don

notes.subject: ילק (yelek)
notes.rationale: sagalen fitinin (young locust) — Ninive ka bɔnibaliyaw ka ɲɛfɔli kɔrɔ Ta Na 3:15-17 la, a bɛ tugu tɛmɛsira in kan

notes.subject: dolow / yalekɛla
notes.rationale: dolow ka caman-caya ni sagalen ka boli taali bɛ ɲɔgɔn falen — jaw sigidaw caman na, nka u bɛna boli i n'a fɔ yalek

translation: I ka jaw sigidaw ka caman-caya, u ka surun sankolow ka dolow la; yalekɛla (yelek) bɛ minɛ ka bɔ, ka togotogo taara.
